project_type: WordPress Elementor plugin (PHP) - Custom widgets with inline styles/JS
build_system: No build system - WordPress plugin (ZIP and install). PHP lint with `php -l`
test_framework: No automated test framework. Manual validation via PHP lint on all .php files
verification_instructions: 1. Run php -l on all plugin PHP files to confirm no syntax errors. 2. Verify preset data arrays are properly structured. 3. Check that each widget's register_controls() includes the preset dropdown at the top of Content tab.
setup_instructions: PHP is pre-installed. No dependencies to install.
environment_constraints: No WordPress runtime available for live testing. Validation is limited to PHP syntax checking and code review.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns: inline styles, PHP arrays for data, Elementor Widget_Base class structure
key_patterns: Each widget extends \Elementor\Widget_Base. Controls registered in register_controls() method. Repeaters use \Elementor\Repeater class. Style tab has color controls. Widgets use inline <style> blocks in render(). Persian text throughout. RTL direction. All widget files in widgets/ directory. Plugin bootstrap in vira-sections.php with register_widgets() loading all widget files.
directory_structure: vira-sections-plugin/ - main plugin. widgets/ - 12 widget class files. includes/ - shared classes. assets/css/ - editor and frontend CSS. docs/ - documentation. sections/ (root) - website-design HTML sections. seo-google/sections/ - SEO Google HTML sections. seo-training-tabriz/sections/ - SEO Training HTML sections. app-android-tabriz/sections/ - App Android HTML sections.
